section.title: Definitions
section.para: Definitions declare new types that can be used throughout a program.

section.title: Structure Definitions
section.para: The define keyword creates a new structure type with named properties.

entry.programlisting: define Point(x: int, y: int) Point(3, 4)
define Point(x: int, y: int) Point(3, 4).x
define Point(x: int, y: int) define Rectangle(origin: Point, width: int, height: int) Rectangle(Point(0, 0), 10, 5).width

section.title: Union Definitions
section.para: Unions define types with multiple variants. Each variant can optionally carry a value.

entry.programlisting: define Option union(Some: int, None) Some(5)
define Option union(Some: int, None) None
define Result union(Ok: int, Err: String) Ok(42)
define Result union(Ok: int, Err: String) Err("error")
define Option union(Some: int, None) Option.Some(5).value

section.title: Function Names
section.para: A routine's role is set by its declaration keyword, not by how its name is spelled. A function may be named with ordinary letters, with a single-quoted string identifier (which may contain spaces), or with operator characters; in every case it is an ordinary function, applied by writing its name before a parenthesized argument.

entry.programlisting: function 'add seven'(n: int) returns int n + 7 'add seven'(35)

section.title: Operator Definitions
section.para: The operator keyword declares an operator, applied infix between its two operands. Like functions, operators may be named with operator characters or with a text or single-quoted name. Operators may be declared at the top level, not only inside a type. A text-named operator binds more weakly than the built-in arithmetic operators, so the arithmetic combines first.

entry.programlisting: operator <+>(left: int, right: int) returns int left + right 40 <+> 2
operator 'plus'(left: int, right: int) returns int left + right 40 'plus' 2
operator 'divided by'(left: int, right: int) returns int left / right 84 'divided by' 2
operator 'minus'(left: int, right: int) returns int left - right 20 'minus' 3 + 5
